ideas.pitch: A manually controlled dual-frequency remote-operated robot optimized for high-speed block gripping and groove insertion.
ideas.title: Shape-Fit Precision Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the core robotics challenge of gripping shapes and inserting them into cubic block grooves, winning on mechanical execution and live operational speed.

ideas.pitch: An interchangeable multi-shape gripper mechanism designed for quick swapping to handle diverse geometric blocks seamlessly.
ideas.title: GripSync Modular End-Effector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates exceptional mechanical flexibility and engineering thoughtfulness when handling various shapes securely during the live arena evaluation.

ideas.pitch: A wired control robot featuring an automated cable-slack management spooling arm to eliminate drag during arena navigation.
ideas.title: Tension-Free Tether Teleop Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the strict rule that wired control cables must remain slack and unhindered, a subtle engineering detail judges will heavily reward.

ideas.pitch: An onboard monocular camera feed transmitting real-time alignment markers to the human operator for pixel-perfect groove insertion.
ideas.title: GrooveAlign Vision-Assist Overlay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines manual driver skill with computer vision assistance, providing a clear competitive edge in precision placement speed.

ideas.pitch: An omnidirectional chassis robot utilizing mecanum wheels paired with a high-torque vertical slide mechanism for rapid block sorting.
ideas.title: Omni-Grip Maneuver Rig
ideas.why_it_could_win: Superior mobility allows the bot to reposition instantly without complex multi-point turns, maximizing points within the short arena run time.
